title: AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.33093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. translated_title: AIChipBench：面向自动化AI加速器设计的LLM智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 语言模型解码器需要在解码步骤之间传递状态，而在硬件中，错误的状态更新可能导致当前token输出正确、却在之后若干个token处破坏结果，因此一个设计可能通过了输出测试却仍然存在错误。AIChipBench探究LLM编程智能体需要具备什么才能正确构建这类硬件。智能体需要用可综合的寄存器传输级（RTL）代码实现量化版的Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器，并以一个可执行的整数参考实现作为规范，该参考规定了每一步解码的输出和存储状态。智能体在固定预算内针对公开测试进行调试；其冻结后的设计会在保留的token序列、复位、内存停顿以及综合等维度上评分；此外还有一条赛道要求智能体在面积几乎不变的前提下对一个正确设计进行加速。在四个编程智能体共9,136次尝试中，难点集中在存储状态上。指出首个状态不匹配位置的反馈能够显著提升设计通过率。
tldr: 该论文提出AIChipBench基准，要求LLM编程智能体用可综合RTL实现量化大模型解码器，重点考察跨解码步骤的状态保持正确性及面积受限下的性能优化，从而系统评估智能体在自动化AI加速器设计中的真实能力。
en_tdlr: AIChipBench is a benchmark that evaluates LLM coding agents on automated AI accelerator design by requiring them to implement quantized LLM decoders in synthesizable RTL, highlighting the challenge of stored-state correctness across decoding steps and performance optimization at nearly fixed area.
